events.text: Mary Thomas married William Morris Thomas.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 5 May 1905 , she married William Morris Thomas , becoming Mary Thomas .

events.text: Mary Thomas took up work as a barmaid again after returning to Perth.
events.subject: self
events.quote: After returning to Perth in 1911 Mary Thomas took up work as a barmaid again

events.text: She bought her first business, the Bon Ton Cafe on Murray Street.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1915 she bought her first business , the Bon Ton Cafe on Murray Street .
